entries.note: The only confirmed US strike (Qeshm air defense) was Friday 6 Nov, before the window; I found no reports of a strike on 7-8 Nov.
ZDF (6 Nov) says Merz and Aigner would appear together on Monday and nothing was officially confirmed; I found no Merz quote from 7-8 Nov.

EFE on 7 Nov reports BCP's Acosta describing a second tranche (G. 10 million up to 40 minimum wages), but it is unclear whether this was a new start-of-payments announcement in the window or part of the earlier plan.
